; Division 960 pulses per quarter divides TPQ exactly (46 126 080 / 960 =
; 48 048), so SMF tick 960 is 1q and 1920 is 2q with nothing to round.
;
; The anchor carries an INLINE DUMP — the document's own copy of the
; file's timing tier — and `song.mid` beside it is the file that dump
; came from, generated by `zig build fixtures`. `:size` and `:sha256` are
; verified before the dump's offsets are honoured (plan 02, "(anchor …)";
; it 03's rule that an offset is only meaningful against this exact
; file), so a regeneration that changed one byte shows up as
; `anchor_mismatch` in the golden rather than drifting quietly.
;
; `(build :kind mid)` writes the inline tier back out, and its hash is
